title: Gradient descent selects the minimum-norm exact fit
provenance: Original course drawing, prepared with Codex; no third-party image copied. Replaces the inherited sketch whose original source could not be identified.

references.title: Cornell CS 3/5780, Spring 2026, Linear Regression, sections 4–5
references.use: Supporting derivation: affine solution set, row/null-space decomposition, zero-initialized gradient descent. Cornell uses data vectors as columns; STAT 709 uses rows.

alt: The blue line beta1+2 beta2=1 contains every exact fit. Green iterates from the origin approach (1/5,2/5) along the perpendicular row-space line. The other fit (1,0) is farther from the origin.
